data.one_liner: Flutter icon pack with 2,105 IcoFont icons as IconData constants
data.what_it_does: Provides a large set of icons as IconData for use in Flutter widgets. The icons are generated from the IcoFont font and exposed as static constants.
use_when: need a wide variety of free icons
need icons that work on all platforms
avoid_when: already using another icon pack that covers your needs
